title: Lieferando Menu & Price Intelligence input
description: Choose German postal codes and the maximum number of restaurants to collect for each location.

postalCodes.title: German postal codes
postalCodes.description: Five-digit German postal codes. Each location is opened through Lieferando postcode-routed result pages. At the Free tier checked on 6 October 2026, delivered menu items, restaurant fallback rows and menu-change summaries cost $0.003 each. Matrices, inflation summaries and the run summary have no result event. Memory-based startup is separate; live Pricing is authoritative.

maxRestaurantsPerPostalCode.title: Restaurants per postal code
maxRestaurantsPerPostalCode.description: Maximum number of unique restaurant branches collected for each postal code.

includeMenus.title: Collect full menus
includeMenus.description: When enabled, outputs one dataset row per menu item. Disable for a faster restaurant-list-only run.

trackPriceHistory.title: Track 90-day price history
trackPriceHistory.description: Persists item price observations in a named key-value store and adds change metrics to each menu row. Keep the same store across scheduled runs so inflation summaries and change fields build real history.

generateAnalytics.title: Generate intelligence reports
generateAnalytics.description: Builds postcode price matrices, menu inflation summaries, CSV/JSON exports, and a visual HTML report.

generateChangeDigest.title: Generate menu change digest
generateChangeDigest.description: Compares observed restaurant menus with previous snapshots in the price-history store and writes MENU_CHANGE_DIGEST (JSON), MENU_CHANGE_DIGEST.html and MENU_CHANGE_DIGEST.txt: observed price, item, availability and delivery-term changes. Requires trackPriceHistory. Active pricing checked on 6 October 2026 has no menu-change-digest event; a successfully stored digest is marked UNPRICED_FREE. Live Pricing and OUTPUT determine billing status.

maxConcurrency.title: Maximum concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of browser pages processed in parallel.

maxRequestRetries.title: Request retries
maxRequestRetries.description: Maximum retry count for blocked or temporarily failing Lieferando pages.

qualityThresholds.title: Quality monitoring thresholds
qualityThresholds.description: Thresholds used to mark the run healthy, degraded, or failed.

maxFailedRequestRate.title: Maximum failed request rate
maxFailedRequestRate.description: Warning threshold expressed as a value from 0 to 1.

maxRetryRate.title: Maximum recovered-retry rate
maxRetryRate.description: Warning threshold for requests that succeeded only after retrying, expressed as a value from 0 to 1.

maxNullPriceRate.title: Maximum null-price rate
maxNullPriceRate.description: Warning threshold expressed as a value from 0 to 1.

minCuisineCoverage.title: Minimum cuisine coverage
minCuisineCoverage.description: Required share of restaurants with a published or inferred cuisine.

minMenuItemsPerRestaurant.title: Minimum menu size
minMenuItemsPerRestaurant.description: Warning threshold for extracted items in each restaurant/postcode menu observation and for the overall average.

customProductAliases.title: Custom product aliases
customProductAliases.description: Optional exact phrase mappings for market-specific names, for example {"Hausrolle":"Signature Wrap"}. Built-in German normalization still applies.

failOnQualityIssues.title: Fail degraded runs
failOnQualityIssues.description: When enabled, marks the Actor run as failed if any quality warning or error is found.

alertWebhookUrl.title: Alert webhook URL
alertWebhookUrl.description: Optional HTTPS endpoint that receives the run-quality summary for degraded or failed runs.

sendSuccessWebhook.title: Send healthy-run webhooks
sendSuccessWebhook.description: Also sends the monitoring webhook when the run is healthy.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Defaults to a German residential Apify Proxy profile because Lieferando may block data-center IPs. The public Pricing tab checked on 6 October 2026 shows platform costs included for customers; the publisher still incurs compute and proxy costs.

restaurantUrls.title: Optional restaurant menu URLs
restaurantUrls.description: Optional direct Lieferando menu URLs. Useful for testing or tracking a fixed competitor set.

url.title: Lieferando menu URL
url.description: Direct URL of one Lieferando restaurant menu.
